# #146 - AI-jätten Anthropic kan bli världens största börsnotering - så tolkar du bolagets S-1 dokument

**Feed**: montrosepodden  
**Published**: 2026-10-29  
**Market Sentiment**: Positive

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

The hosts call this week 'morning air in the AI trade'. After last week's AI scare, worries about returns on huge datacenter capex have eased, and money is rotating into equal-weighted and small-cap stocks, which they see as healthy. Most of the episode explains how to read an S-1, using Anthropic's filing for a Nasdaq listing as the example: revenue up 1368%, 900% net revenue retention, a large loss and a founder golden share. It ends with quick takes on Scandi Standard, Hexagon's defense-driven growth and the cybersecurity rally in the US.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟢 ATCO-A — Atlas Copco | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 70%

Host added to his holding after a 15% fall in 10 days on datacenter worries. The CEO and a board member also bought.

#### Reasoning

The host bought more ('dra i plåstret') after Atlas fell about 15% between 13 and 23 October on fears around datacenter exposure. Insider buys by CEO Vagner Rego and Johan Forsell, whose past timing has been good, support the view that the drop is about sentiment rather than the business. He calls it adding to an old favourite in the portfolio.

#### Sell Triggers

- if order intake keeps disappointing
- if the datacenter/AI capex cycle reverses for real
- if insiders start selling

> *"Det fick mig faktiskt att dra i plåstret lite grann. Även vd Wagner Rego och även Johan Forsell, Investors tidigare vd som sitter i styrelsen för Atlas. Det var en liten köparfest där."*

---

### 🟠 HEXA-B — Hexagon | **WATCH** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 55%

Best organic growth in five years (+13%). Autonomous Solutions grew 23% on defence demand. Europe wants positioning tech that does not depend on Starlink.

#### Reasoning

The host believes Hexagon's anti-jamming and sensor-fusion positioning (NovAtel) fits rising defence budgets and NATO's push to avoid relying on SpaceX/Starlink. Defence, space and aviation make up about a quarter of Autonomous Solutions sales. He suggests this part of the business deserves more market attention, but frames it as a hunch.

#### Sell Triggers

- if defence-driven growth in Autonomous Solutions slows
- if organic growth falls back below the 10-12% target
- if worries about depending on Starlink fade

> *"Den här delen kanske borde kunna få lite mera kärlek. Jag skulle kunna ana det i alla fall."*

---

### 🟠 SCST — Scandi Standard | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 45%

Ready-to-eat segment sales +25% and profit +220%. The shift to higher-value products is praised. Stock up ~500% since 2022.

#### Reasoning

The host likes the move from commodity chicken to value-added ready-to-eat products such as Kronfågel 'ätklar', which sells at a 133% premium. That shift drove a 25% sales rise and 220% profit rise in the RTE segment, and he calls it smart. He praises how the company is run but gives no explicit buy call, and notes the stock is already up about 500%.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the RTE segment's growth or margins fade
- if consumers stop paying premium prices
- if group EBIT growth stalls

> *"Det här har ju Scandi Standard gjort bra alldeles uppenbarligen."*

---

### 🟠 ANT — Anthropic | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 40%

Revenue +1368%, NRR 900%, and costs falling while margins hold. The host warns this is no reason to jump into the IPO, citing an ~$2tn valuation target and founder control.

#### Reasoning

The S-1 shows explosive growth: $16.29bn H1 revenue, 900% NRR, about $6.6m revenue per employee, and Jevons-paradox-style demand growth. Against that, the loss was $80.7bn, the founders keep 50.1% of votes through a class F share, and the valuation may target around $2tn. The host is enthusiastic about the business but explicitly says not to rush into the listing.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the IPO is priced around $2tn with no path to profit
- if losses keep growing faster than revenue
- if founder control leads to decisions that hurt minority shareholders

> *"Det är inte samma sak som att man ska kasta sig över den här noteringen. Det är inte det jag säger."*
